MK3 frame

Open Lab Automata's MK3 structural profiles are licensed under the CERN Open
Hardware Licence v2, strongly reciprocal. The full license and upstream notice
are in CERN-OHL-S-2.0.txt in this directory.

Source at commit b3f0c20615c7595e6b2b22d72bb7132a9f409158
https://gitlab.com/open-la/pipettin-bot/-/tree/b3f0c20615c7595e6b2b22d72bb7132a9f409158/models/MK3/structure

Modified on 2026-11-20. The visible profiles from PROF-2020V.FCStd and their
placements in AS-STRUCTURE.FCStd were tessellated, centered on the base, and
converted from millimeters to meters. The mesh uses a USD Preview Surface
material. mk3_frame.usdc is the editable USD form of the adapted frame.

Erlenmeyer flask

The Erlenmeyer flask mesh (qt_lab_000016) is by QUIKTECH. It is licensed under
Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0).
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

Source at commit 05b4f3d27093e127c2983a5b6c583a333debd1e8
https://huggingface.co/datasets/quiktech/SimReady-Assets/tree/05b4f3d27093e127c2983a5b6c583a333debd1e8/qt_lab_000016

The visual mesh was extracted and a USD Preview Surface glass material was
assigned. The packaged flask is a static prop.
